casea_covered_button.case: button covered by opaque overlay; blind tap must NOT count

casec_corrupt_png.case: control layout; corrupt asset lives in res/raw and is DECODED-BUT-NEVER-SHOWN (decode taxonomy probe fixture; verifier must list DECODE_FAILURE if it is ever required)

cased_splash.case: 5s splash then main scene; short capture window must produce splash-only -> NOT fully verified (readiness law)

casee_not_clickable.case: icon visible but no click listener; interaction stages must not pass

casef_silent_callback.case: callback fires but NO visual change (S92 addendum 30: computation/state pass must NOT promote to FULL)

caseg_density.case: 48dp slot fed ONLY by a 144px xxhdpi asset; measured displayed size must equal 48px at 160dpi runtime (density law); wrong size = DENSITY_MISMATCH

good.case: control: real icon + working button + visible state change

note: required_verdict: ACCEPT = verifier must not fail the title on its visual contract; REJECT* = verifier MUST fail the named stage; MEASURE = record real behavior, judge by density law 48px @160dpi
